provenance.source: Built-in OpenAI ImageGen weapon-free sports-v1 and hands-first dives-v1 sheets
provenance.method: Connected-component source extraction; alpha210 threshold; shared64 color palette; nearest sampling; six masked teal-uniform material palettes; no drawn athlete anatomy
provenance.limitations: Key poses, not hand-cleaned full inbetween animation. Pass/trap reuse kick frames; Dig/dive use independently generated hands-first poses. Jump is cosmetic contact animation, no player jump physics.
